data.one_liner: A bugless implementation of BigDecimal in Dart based on Java's BigDecimal.
data.what_it_does: Provides a BigDecimal implementation in Dart for handling precise decimal arithmetic. Helps avoid floating-point precision issues inherent in standard numeric types.
use_when: You need precise decimal arithmetic for financial or mathematical calculations
You want to avoid precision loss from standard double types
avoid_when: You are doing simple performance-critical integer calculations where native numbers suffice
strengths: Based on Java's well-tested BigDecimal implementation
weaknesses: May have overhead compared to native primitives

alternatives.name: rational
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer exact rational number representation instead of arbitrary-precision decimals.
